criteriaNotes.1_topdown_view: Large blobs read as flat dark ground. Isolated single cell (651/697) becomes a tiny star-shaped fleck that reads as a tuft/sprig object; 1-cell-wide bands read as chains of small sprigs. Small 2x2 clusters form spiky star silhouettes (pinched waists) - borderline plant-like.
criteriaNotes.2_autotile_seams: Systematic defect in the shared edge contract: thin-arm edge pixels do not line up across seams (N edge cols 8-10 vs S edge col 7; E edge row 11 vs W edge rows 8,12), so connections are diagonal-only single pixels. Border stub pixels (15,11),(0,12),(7,15)-(8,14) are detached from the cell's dark body in 34 of 46 masks -> floating flecks at seams. Blob edges with both flanking diagonals join fine. Unconnected edges are clean (all-light border rows).
criteriaNotes.3_colour_fit: The 4 new colours (#759951,#688c48,#81a359,#8aab60) are a coherent desaturated version of 737 and sit naturally against the dark grass and crowns in s1-s8. No off-palette or muddy look.
criteriaNotes.4_style_fit: Dark interior and dither are the original 11628 texture; edge dither is consistent with the sheet. No smeared/generated noise. Woodland cells are pixel-identical in dark layout to plain cells.
criteriaNotes.5_map_renders: Under crowns, forest-edge dark grass reads as natural ground. Long straight edges (675/682/693 repeated) show a regular 16px sawtooth that leans grid-aligned in s4-forest-farm (NE forest edge, south band), not a hard slab. Isolated single cells appear as stray specks in fields.

cells.reasons: Woodland base: same texture as city 737, desaturated; the 4 new colours sit between 737 and the dark grass and look natural in s1-s8/r6 maps. No seam issue on its own (path-edge tiles that keep 737 margins show a very slight saturation step, not this cell's art).
